items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: They had another man for it, and Mr. Johnny had it.

ctx.x: Yeah, when you first started out. Yeah, when you first started out. I'll turn it off for a second. You started on Burger Street when you were about fifteen. Was that playing piano by yourself or was it playing piano?
Played a little drum. You remember, you used to call this place the, you know the Dream Room? Yeah. They had another man for it, and Mr. Johnny had it.
Oh yeah, I can't think now. I remember once George Lewis played there for a while and then a band from Dayton, Ohio was now.
